column1: # alloclint paths (crosscheck.py `paths` column; report section 4): path<TAB>operator families (regex, full match) whose
# runtime roots reach a site<TAB>why. An operator family is a plain name (<crate>/src/**/ops/<op>/, kernels' par_* and agg
# tables); `shared` = no named-path family reaches the site but shared machinery does (`x:y` families: run machinery run:*,
# expression evaluation expr:*, lowerv4's shared:* helpers, exec / hosts code outside ops/): it may lie on any path; `other` = reached only from other operator families; `-` = no family.
